address: Hôtel d'Europe, 12 place Crillon, Avignon, 84000, France
bio: Wood panelling, mouldings and a fireplace set the elegant Provençal scene of this venerable establishment. Pascal Auger is in his element, crafting Mediterranean fare steeped in the aromas and flavours of the south. On sunny days (you’re in Avignon!) you can enjoy these delicacies beneath the ancient plane tree on the terrace facing a fountain....
